title: <PROBLEM NAME> solution
description: TEMPLATE (methodology asset A-P3-tpl-sol-schema). Structure of a candidate SOLUTION for <PROBLEM>: the realized decisions only. This is the object a technique (MILP or heuristic) emits and the checker consumes. Do NOT restate the instance (input data) here; keep the two schemas disjoint. Fill every <PLACEHOLDER>, keep the skeleton, and delete this sentence. Each top-level decision block SHOULD map back to a decision symbol in the P5 MILP formulation / P1 Decision section. Use `additionalProperties: false` everywhere to catch typos; list only genuinely-required blocks in `required`.

<primary_decision>.description: The main decision set (e.g. an assignment / selection / sequencing). One entry per realized decision. Rename to your decision symbol.

<entity_ref>.description: Id of the instance entity this decision is about (must exist in the instance).

<value>.description: Realized decision value; adjust type/domain (integer/number/string/boolean) to the decision variable.

<secondary_decision>.description: OPTIONAL second decision block, e.g. a map id -> chosen resource. Remove if the problem has a single decision family.

objective.description: Objective value the technique reports for this solution. The checker's get_objective() recomputes it from the decisions and should match (within tolerance).
